convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iCCI, custom MA via iMA). Simple crossover entry/exit rules with fixed SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic. Standard position sizing with optional fraction mode.

platform_context.has_digit_adjustment: true if SL/TP multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001

derived_values.name: KWAN CCC composite signal line

derived_values.used_by: crossover entry rules and signal reversal exit

derived_values.used_by: crossover entry rules and signal reversal exit

long.right: KWAN MA (Base Line) LWMA of CCI

short.right: KWAN MA (Base Line) LWMA of CCI

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot size (abs value); Positive Lots value = fraction of free margin (Lots/100 of free margin)

custom_logic_notes: The KWAN CCC indicator applies two moving averages (EMA short-period and LWMA long-period) directly to the CCI indicator buffer values, creating a composite momentum oscillator. Crossover of the EMA-of-CCI (signal) above the LWMA-of-CCI (base) triggers long; crossover below triggers short. The EA closes the opposite position on signal reversal before entering a new trade. Position sizing uses a dual-mode system: negative input = absolute fixed lots, positive input = percentage of free margin (Lots/100). Digit adjustment is applied to SL/TP values for 5-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. The core logic is: (1) compute CCI with period input, (2) apply EMA(period_short) and LWMA(period_long) to the CCI series, (3) detect crossovers on completed bars (bar[-1] vs bar[-2]). The dual MA-on-CCI approach is easily replicated in pandas. Digit adjustment for SL/TP is a simple 10x multiplier when price decimals >= 5. Position sizing branch on sign of Lots input is trivial. No custom indicators or external libraries needed.
